summary: Assertio Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 1, 2026, disclosing an amended merger agreement with Garda Therapeutics, Inc. (Parent) and Audi Merger Sub, Inc. (Purchaser). Parent will acquire Assertio via a cash tender offer for all outstanding shares at $21.80 per share in cash, up from the original $18.00 per share plus a contingent value right. The board unanimously approved and recommends acceptance. The tender offer expires 20 business days after commencement on May 4, 2026, followed by a merger. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder tenders; risk-arb spread depends on deal certainty and timing.
